text: Caught in a Colorado blizzard, novelist Paul Sheldon [crashes his Mustang over an embankment|trigger|a sudden accident or attack] and wakes with broken legs in the remote house of Annie Wilkes, a nurse and his self-proclaimed number one fan. When she learns he has killed off his heroine Misery Chastain, she [forces him to burn his new manuscript|images|fire, smoke and burning] and write Misery back to life. Locked doors, a dead phone and a sledgehammer [keep him in her spare room|wants|keeping people forever].
